framework.title: Durable Execution & Daily Consolidation Integrator — Hardened Supervisor + Daily-Present Genome
framework.description: Production extension of DurableDreamRunner + DurableJobSupervisor with explicit lease heartbeat/renewal (daemon keeper + heartbeat_lease API), jittered exponential backoff, child job metadata hierarchy (parent/depth/lineage), and richer status/history surfaces surfacing lease state. Introduces supervisor-driven run_daily_consolidation_job that executes Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + synthesis and emits attributed daily-present genome carrying fusion_checkpoint. Schema pack extended with daily-present page_type (extractable + expert_routing). Auto-feeds experience layer v3 for role-swarm coherence via schema-driven promotion and KG edges. All framed exclusively in AgentDrive primitives: role-specialized swarms, shared drive/KG, experience layer v3 auto-incorporation, hybrid fusion + graph signals, durable durable role-swarm execution.

steps.output: Reviewed lease handling (two-phase pending→running), simple backoff, basic child list, status surfaces in durable.py
Added explicit heartbeat_lease + daemon renewal loop during long phases (5min base, 30s cadence); mirrored lease state to DreamJob.metadata
Replaced linear backoff with jittered exponential (random 0.75-1.25 factor, capped 60s) in _run_queued retry path
Extended QueuedDreamJob + submit/spawn with parent_job_id, depth, lineage; propagated on child creation and persisted
Enhanced get_status_summary, get_recent_history (lease_state annotations), get_queue_status (leased_jobs + hierarchy + lease_support marker)
Implemented run_daily_consolidation_job: Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) over family + graph, fusion_checkpoint construction, daily-present genome payload with schema page_type + diary
Added daily-present PageType to AGENTDRIVE_DRIVE_PACK (prefixes, extractable, expert_routing, description referencing supervisor daily_consolidation and experience layer v3)
Extended auto_attributed_ingest_from_dream_job for daily_consolidation/fusion_checkpoint → kind daily-present; updated dreaming __init__ exports

Added production guidance section in SELF_HOSTING.md with code patterns using only AgentDrive terms (DurableJobSupervisor, daily_consolidation, prefer_experience_layer, fusion_checkpoint, schema page_type, experience layer v3)
Produced signed subagent report artifact (md + this genome JSON) for live drive ingestion and self-improvement loop closure

framework.integration: Works with DreamEngine (via DurableDreamRunner), synthesis engine, knowledge_graph (graph signals), Drive (think + ingest + experience layer wiring), schema_packs (page_type boosts), and parallel stabilization swarms. Daily-present artifacts become citable primary entries in experience layer v3 for Conductors.

provenance.self_referential: This genome itself is a candidate for ingestion as daily-present artifact; subsequent daily_consolidation will cite it via experience layer.

fusion_checkpoint.changes_summary: Lease renewal + jittered backoff + hierarchy + richer lease-surfacing status + new daily_consolidation job producing daily-present + schema page_type + SELF_HOSTING guidance
fusion_checkpoint.experience_layer_impact: Enables unattended daily consolidation that synthesizes parallel swarm outputs into coherent fused daily present (living-experience entrypoint)

reasoning_patterns.durable_lease_heartbeat: heartbeat during long phases prevents expiry on consolidation-scale work
reasoning_patterns.jittered_retry: avoids synchronized retry storms across role-specialized swarms
reasoning_patterns.child_hierarchy: enables decomposition of complex daily_present synthesis without losing provenance
reasoning_patterns.daily_present: schema page_type + fusion_checkpoint ensures high-signal auto-incorporation into experience layer v3
